messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: synthetic-probe/svcs-gen-availability in us-west-2 (5xx ratio > 2% for 3m). Incident severity: P2.
alex chen: I got it, ack. seeing a burst of alerts from the synth probes across multiple hosts.
maria gonzalez: same. dashboards look noisy but upstream API latency is fine on real traffic. could be a probe misfire.
jamal price: copying logs, one of the probe clusters hit timeout 504 for ~30s then recovered. attaching recent probe log: `curl -sS -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null https://svc-gen/api/health` returned 504 at 03:12:07 UTC across 6 probes.
noah li: hmm, those probes are on a 30s cadence, we might be seeing correlated DNS blips from the egress layer.
alex chen: tentative plan: 1) silence noisy pager channel for synth-probe alerts while we triage 2) throttle probe frequency to reduce noise 3) quick impact check for customers.
maria gonzalez: agree. no support tickets so far. running a quick query: `sum(rate(client_errors[5m])) by (customer)` shows no spike.
jamal price: i'll mute the pager for 15m for synth-probe alerts and post every 5m updates. executing: `incident mute --alert synth-probe/svcs-gen-availability --duration 15m --reason "investigating probe storm"`
incident-bot: Action acknowledged: alert-silence created (#A-23456) by jamal price for 15m.
noah li: while muted, let's reduce cadence to 90s for the affected cohort. config patch below — rolling to probe-group-usw2-A:
```
probe_config:
  name: svc-gen-health
  cadence_seconds: 90
  timeout_seconds: 7
  consecutive_failures: 3
  dedupe_window_seconds: 120
```
alex chen: good. also enable random jitter on cadence to avoid lockstep; add `jitter_pct: 20` to that config.
maria gonzalez: making the patch now to the runtime template, rolling to 3 nodes first, then canary eval.
jamal price: deploying canary config to probe-group-usw2-A/3 -> patch applied. i'll watch for immediate alerts.
incident-bot: Deploy event: probe-config-rollout to probe-group-usw2-A/3 by maria gonzalez.
noah li: after the config change, failures dropped to single-digit windows. looks like lockstep amplified the blip.
alex chen: customer impact: none observed. support queue empty. mark as "no customer impact" for post-incident notes.
maria gonzalez: recording action items: 1) add jitter by default for all synth probes 2) add adaptive backoff when >N probes fail in same AZ 3) improve dedupe logic to collapse same root cause alerts across instances 4) dashboard: synth-probe rollup with per-AZ summary + correlated egress/DNS metrics.
jamal price: agree. I'll open a short-lived dashboard and a dashboard ticket: `DECK-1234`.
noah li: we should also add an anomaly filter: if external DNS errors spike, suppress synth-probe paging and fallback to passive logging for 10m. avoids wake-the-pager for infra-level events.
alex chen: can we add a quick query threshold change so synth-probe->pager requires at least 2 probe groups failing, not just instances? probably reduces noise.
maria gonzalez: yes. proposal: change pager rule to `count(distinct probe_group where failure) >= 2 and failure_rate > 1.5%` — will draft.
jamal price: unmuting in 2m to validate config behavior under normal paging rules.
incident-bot: Alert-silence expires in 2 minutes (#A-23456).
alex chen: handoff: i'm off in 30m; jamal will be primary for the remainder of shift. jamal please summarize state and next steps.
jamal price: state: probe config rolled to canary (3 nodes) with 90s cadence + 20% jitter; immediate noise reduced; no customer impact. next steps: roll config to remaining probe-nodes, create DECK-1234 dashboard, and PR for pager-rule change. scheduled owner: maria gonzalez.
maria gonzalez: taking dashboard + PR. i'll include runbook snippet: how to mute synth-probe on incident and when to escalate to platform infra.
noah li: i'll follow up on egress DNS anomaly root cause with infra team — sounds like a transient provider DNS outage around 03:12 UTC.
alex chen: thanks team. i'll file a short post-incident note in incidents/ and tag this thread. final status: mitigated, mitigation: probe cadence + jitter + dedupe adjustments, impact: none, follow-ups tracked in DECK-1234 and PR-5678.
jamal price: thanks — handing over to next oncall. :wave:
maria gonzalez: good job. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Thread closed by alex chen (manual).
